items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Simply search for a salon or service, pick an available time slot, and confirm your booking in seconds — no phone calls needed.

items.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule directly from your dashboard up until the salon's cancellation window.

items.question: Is SalonFlow free to use?
items.answer: Yes, booking through SalonFlow is completely free for clients. Salons pay a small service fee per booking.
